svg.aria-label: Mock backend CPU per second at I/O-bound 70 percent
svg.text: At I/O-bound 70 % the backend jumps under both pinned arms, and under neither floating one
mock JVM CPU per second of the measurement window (pidstat; two CPUs, so 200 % is its ceiling) · one line per trial, 5 fresh JVMs per arm, 43,400 req/s · campaign 20261016T034438Z
B_pin: all five trials rise from ~130 % to 159–199 % between seconds 47 and 53; D: four of five to 182–198 % at second 53, and the fifth, without the jump, is D's fastest trial.
A_iso and C_iso never exceed 146 %. At 75 % and above no arm's mock jumps; the event belongs to pinned carriers at this rate, not to the custom scheduler.
